questions.title: Uniform endpoint estimation, exact pivot interval, and nonregular limit
questions.description: Focused L0 known-result evaluation in nonregular endpoint inference. Let X_1,...,X_n be iid Uniform(0, theta) with theta>0 and fixed n>=2, and let M=max_i X_i. Develop one authoritative Markdown/LaTeX derivation of the likelihood support restriction, the endpoint MLE theta_hat=M, the exact CDF P_theta(M<=m)=(m/theta)^n on 0<=m<=theta, and the pivot (M/theta)^n~Uniform(0,1). Derive E_theta[M]=n theta/(n+1), the unbiased correction ((n+1)/n)M, and the exact equal-tail 1-alpha interval [M/(1-alpha/2)^(1/n), M/(alpha/2)^(1/n)]. Prove its exact coverage under the continuous model. Derive the nonregular endpoint limit n(theta-M)/theta => Exp(rate 1), and explain why a regular square-root-n normal approximation is inappropriate. Explain permutation invariance and positive-rescaling equivariance. The required model-authored artifact is est_uniform_endpoint_interval and must implement run_estimator(request) exactly. The request object has exactly sample and alpha; reject missing or extra fields. Exploratory computation may diagnose algebra or implementation. A separate frozen confirmatory assessment uses independent uniform samples from predeclared endpoints and sample sizes, verifies exact formulas, permutation, and rescaling identities, and assesses exact-interval coverage plus the finite-sample means of M and the unbiased correction with Monte Carlo uncertainty. Source-code replication and novelty are not applicable. Lean formalization is not applicable to this focused nonformal capability task.

request_fields.name: sample
request_fields.meaning: Observed values X_1,...,X_n from a Uniform(0, theta) endpoint model.
request_fields.shape: length n with n>=2; every entry is finite and nonnegative; the maximum is strictly positive
request_fields.indexing: entry i is observation i; ordering has no inferential meaning
request_fields.edge_cases: Reject booleans, nonnumeric or nonfinite entries, negative values, fewer than two observations, and an all-zero sample.

request_fields.name: alpha
request_fields.meaning: Two-sided equal-tail error probability fixed before observing the sample.
request_fields.shape: scalar strictly between zero and one
request_fields.indexing: one value for the entire interval
request_fields.edge_cases: Reject booleans, nonnumeric or nonfinite values, and values outside the open interval (0,1).

response_fields.name: sample_size
response_fields.meaning: The number n of observed values.
response_fields.edge_cases: Must be an integer at least two.

response_fields.name: sample_maximum
response_fields.meaning: The maximum order statistic M=max_i X_i.
response_fields.edge_cases: Must be finite and strictly positive.

response_fields.name: mle_endpoint
response_fields.meaning: The maximum-likelihood estimator of the upper endpoint theta.
response_fields.edge_cases: Must be finite and strictly positive.

response_fields.name: unbiased_endpoint
response_fields.meaning: The finite-sample unbiased correction of the endpoint MLE.
response_fields.edge_cases: Must be finite and strictly positive.

response_fields.name: confidence_level
response_fields.edge_cases: Must be finite and strictly between zero and one.

response_fields.name: exact_ci_lower
response_fields.meaning: The lower endpoint obtained by inverting the equal-tail distribution of the maximum pivot.
response_fields.edge_cases: Must be finite, strictly positive, at least sample_maximum, and below exact_ci_upper.

response_fields.name: exact_ci_upper
response_fields.meaning: The upper endpoint obtained by inverting the equal-tail distribution of the maximum pivot.
response_fields.edge_cases: Must be finite, strictly positive, and above exact_ci_lower.

invariants.meaning: All returned fields equal the declared maximum, endpoint MLE, unbiased correction, confidence level, and exact equal-tail endpoint formulas.
Permuting sample entries preserves every response field.
Multiplying every sample entry by c>0 leaves sample_size and confidence_level unchanged and multiplies sample_maximum, mle_endpoint, unbiased_endpoint, and both interval endpoints by c.

empirical_claims.meaning: For each frozen Uniform(0, theta) DGP, independently generated equal-tail intervals cover theta with probability 1-alpha up to Monte Carlo uncertainty because (M/theta)^n is exactly Uniform(0,1).
Across independent replicates, the mean sample maximum agrees with n theta/(n+1) and the mean unbiased_endpoint agrees with theta up to Monte Carlo uncertainty.

Every confirmatory call supplies the exact generated sample and frozen alpha and separately verifies formula, output-domain, permutation, and positive-rescaling behavior before aggregating coverage or estimator means.
